messages:
rachel (devex): heads-up: we need to finalize SDK defaults for telemetry sampling before beta publish. TL;DR: proposals range 0.01 to 0.1. Need opinions based on expected traffic and console accuracy.

omar (eng-platform): my preference 0.02 default. lower noise on ingestion cost but still useful for trend detection.

lia (console): 0.05 gives better per-route charts for smaller tenants. we can surface sample_rate in UI and rescale counts.

dan (eng): remember mobile customers may have bursty patterns; keep SDK queuing robust. Go usage stats indicate fewer but higher throughput clients.

sre-bot: Reminder: ingestion budget for telemetry is 2k events/s. Exceeding will trigger autoscaling ops playbook.

rachel (devex): decision: default sample_rate=0.02, opt-in only. will update SDK PRs and docs. lia add a note in Console about rescaling estimates.

omar (eng-platform): i'll land the change in the Py SDK PR and add tests for queue drop behavior.

lia (console): will add sample_rate badge on charts.

dan (eng): noted about Go; will prototype helper with context Close pattern.
